reviews.author: Sierbahnn
reviews.content: There are several movies like this with Winnie the Pooh and Popeye and Mickey Muscle coming into the public domain and all being used for cheap horror schlock. This movie does work however while the others really couldn't pull through in their own right. This is just a really good horror movie. It has characters that you can engage with and an antagonist whose motives are understandable and this allows tension to be built naturally. The twist feels justified and the ending is earned and it's just a good time overall I think this is worthy recommendation.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Manipulated by a sinister cricket and driven by a naive desire to protect his human brother, a living wooden puppet goes on a gruesome killing spree to carve himself into a real flesh-and-blood boy.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Grieving teenager James is given a living wooden puppet named Pinocchio by his eccentric grandfather Geppetto to serve as a companion. Encouraged by a manipulative Talking Cricket and a dark entity, Pinocchio comes to believe that eliminating anyone who upsets James will protect his new friend. As his misguided obsession deepens, the puppet harvests human organs and body parts from his victims to attach to his wooden frame. James and his friends must race to stop Pinocchio's bloody crusade before he completes his horrifying physical transformation.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: After losing his parents, young James moves in with his grandfather Geppetto, an inventor attempting to cure his grandson's isolation. Geppetto creates Pinocchio, a sentient wooden puppet, hoping to provide James with an eternal friend and companion. While James forms a bond with Pinocchio, the puppet encounters a sinister entity known as the Wood Mother and a dark Talking Cricket hidden in the workshop. The Cricket manipulates Pinocchio's naive worldview, convincing him that he must violently eliminate anyone who causes James pain or inconvenience. Believing this bloody crusade will protect James and help him become a real boy, Pinocchio begins murdering local townspeople and harvesting their flesh, teeth, and organs. Pinocchio attaches these harvested human parts to his own wooden anatomy, growing increasingly monstrous as he targets bullies and authority figures. Discovering Geppetto's failed past creations and Pinocchio's gruesome body count, James and his friends race to stop the killer puppet. Pinocchio eventually realizes the Cricket and Wood Mother lied to him, turning his violent wrath upon his corruptors. In a tense final confrontation in Geppetto's burning workshop, James manages to escape the carnage as Pinocchio's reign of terror consumes his creator.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Pinocchio: Unstrung is a dark, blood-soaked horror reimagining of Carlo Collodi's classic tale. When young James loses his parents, he goes to live with his reclusive, craftsman grandfather, Geppetto. Desperate to heal the boy's lingering grief and loneliness, Geppetto constructs Pinocchio, a sentient wooden puppet designed to be a loyal, lifelong companion. However, Pinocchio's innocent understanding of humanity is quickly warped by sinister forces lurking within the workshop, including a corrupt Talking Cricket. Guided by toxic advice, Pinocchio embarks on a violent crusade to eliminate any perceived threat to James, harvesting human tissue from his victims in a twisted quest to become a real boy.

story_structure.climax: The escalating violence culminates in a terrifying, high-stakes confrontation where Pinocchio seeks the final, vital pieces needed to complete his transformation at the direct expense of those closest to him.
story_structure.conflict: Driven by an obsessive desire to become a real boy and gain his father's love, Pinocchio is convinced by the Cricket to harvest human body parts to carve himself into a human, one piece at a time.
story_structure.resolution: In the grim aftermath of the confrontation, the tragic reality of Pinocchio's bloody obsession leaves the survivors fundamentally shattered and bearing the dark consequences of his unnatural quest.
story_structure.introduction: Geppetto constructs a wooden puppet named Pinocchio, who lives in the shadow of his human brother James and under the dark, manipulative influence of a sinister Cricket.
story_structure.risingAction: Pinocchio embarks on a bloody crusade to acquire human components, leaving a trail of terror as Geppetto and James desperately attempt to reckon with the monstrous horror unleashed from their own home.

faq.answer: Yes, it is the fifth entry in Jagged Edge Productions' Twisted Childhood Universe (TCU), which includes other horror retellings like Winnie-the-Pooh: Blood and Honey and Peter Pan's Neverland Nightmare.
faq.question: Is Pinocchio: Unstrung part of a movie franchise?

faq.answer: The dominant genre is horror, specifically falling into the slasher and body horror subgenres with graphic splatter elements.
faq.question: What is the dominant genre of Pinocchio: Unstrung?

faq.answer: Yes, true to the Twisted Childhood Universe formula, the film features an end-credits tease setting up the major crossover film Poohniverse: Monsters Assemble.
faq.question: Is there a post-credits scene in Pinocchio: Unstrung?

faq.answer: The film was written and directed by Rhys Frake-Waterfield, who also spearheaded previous entries in the Twisted Childhood Universe.
faq.question: Who directed and wrote Pinocchio: Unstrung?

faq.answer: Created by Geppetto to comfort his grandson James, a naive wooden puppet named Pinocchio is manipulated by a sinister Cricket into a violent, bloody crusade to harvest human body parts to become a real boy.
faq.question: What is the main plot premise of Pinocchio: Unstrung?

faq.answer: The film stars Richard Brake as Geppetto, horror icon Robert Englund as the voice of the Cricket, Cameron Bell as James, and Jude Evan Lloyd providing the voice of Pinocchio.
faq.question: Who are the key cast members in the film?

faq.answer: Yes, production prioritized realistic practical animatronics and puppetry created by Emmy winner Todd Masters over CGI to give the puppet a tangible, terrifying presence on screen.
faq.question: Were practical effects used to bring Pinocchio to life?

faq.answer: No, the movie is rated R for strong bloody horror violence and gore, language, and brief graphic nudity, making it strictly intended for mature audiences.
faq.question: Is Pinocchio: Unstrung suitable for children?

faq.answer: It is a dark reimagining of the classic 1883 novel The Adventures of Pinocchio by Italian author Carlo Collodi, which is now in the public domain.
faq.question: What original source material is the movie based on?

faq.answer: Yes, Pinocchio is set to team up with other corrupted storybook characters in the upcoming franchise crossover, Poohniverse: Monsters Assemble.
